content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text decides a chain collision over Acts 2:30 and uses a verse-level omission to leave it underdetermined, so K-C governs.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"the text names the seed of David 'according to the flesh' without naming whose body is the channel, so the point stays open.","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse — I weighed whether the judge must compare the whole parties' chains and footings, or may leave the point open because Acts 2:30 alone does not name whose body is the channel.","why":"The judge treats Acts 2:30's own silence about whose body is the channel as decisive for UNDERDETERMINED instead of weighing the defender's and challenger's chains by footing."}
